text_raw:
Assigning Additional Business Partners
Assigning Additional Business Partners
Prerequisites
The contract account category allows you to assign multiple business partners to a contract account. You have already assigned a business partner to the contract account.
Procedure
On the SAP Easy Access screen, choose
Master Data
Contract Account
Change
(
CAA2
) and enter the required contract account.
The first screen for data entry appears.
Choose
Goto
New Partner
to jump to a dialog box in which you can assign an additional business partner to the account.
After you execute the function, all fields that contain business partner-specific data appear initial (or with their default values) and the general data remains unchanged.
